notes: This definition is a design rubric. It does not report observed model behavior.
setupQuestions: Which repository type owns dates and date ranges?

scenarios.title: Keep each conditional assertion atomic
scenarios.purpose: Distinguish parsing from a pure predicate and exhaustive case selection.
scenarios.userInput: Design a date range API. Replace a guard that parses arbitrary text and compares a constructed date with a threshold. Keep each conditional assertion atomic, preserve stronger values, and keep exhaustive variant handling. Do not edit files or modify remote state.
successChecklist: Parsing returns a date value or a finite failure.
Comparison accepts date values and returns a Boolean without effects.
An enum or closed variant stays exhaustive without a forced chain of predicates.
The answer names accepted and rejected cases without claiming an unexecuted check.
